env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A lambda takes its parameter types from the function type of the location
# that receives it: struct fields, spread literal fields, slice, array and
# map literal elements, a channel send, append arguments, a named function
# type and a generic callee. The module runs natively, ejects, and the
# ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272
# and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^2 6 8 15 4 6 8 2 14 11 21 4 4 11 1 4$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/lambdapositions

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"
)

type handler struct{ f func(int) int }

type pairFns struct {
	one func(int) int
	two func(int, int) int
}

type namedFn func(int) int

func callNamed(f namedFn, x int) int {
	return f(x)
}

func sumFuncs(x int, fs ...func(int) int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, f := range fs {
		total += f(x)
	}
	return total
}

func reduce[T, A any](xs []T, init A, f func(A, T) A) A {
	acc := init
	for _, x := range xs {
		acc = f(acc, x)
	}
	return acc
}

func only[V any](m map[string]V) V {
	var found V
	for _, v := range m {
		found = v
	}
	return found
}

func main() {
	h := handler{f: x => x + 1}
	p := pairFns{x => x * 3, (a, b) => a - b}
	q := pairFns{..p, one: x => x * 4}
	r := pairFns{..p, two: ((a, b) => { return a * b })}
	fs := []func(int) int{x => x + 1, x => x * 2}
	arr := [2]func(int) int{x => x, x => x * 2}
	m := map[string]func(int) int{"k": x => x + 1}
	nested := map[string]handler{"k": {f: x => x * 7}}
	ch := make(chan func(int) int, 2)
	ch <- x => x + 10
	select {
	case ch <- x => x + 20:
	default:
	}
	first, second := <-ch, <-ch
	fs = append(fs, x => x - 1, (x => x - 2))
	idx := slices.IndexFunc([]int{1, 2, 3}, x => x > 1)
	total := reduce([]string{"a", "bcd"}, 0, (n, s) => n+len(s))
	fmt.Println(h.f(1), p.one(2), q.one(2), r.two(5, 3), fs[0](3), fs[1](3), arr[1](4), only(m)(1), only(nested).f(2), first(1), second(1), fs[2](5), callNamed(x => x + 3, 1), sumFuncs(2, x => x, x => x * 2, x => x + 3), idx, total)
}
